about: Written by the Tabibu developer from the WHO/UNICEF manual before the first benchmark run. 'facts' are case-insensitive regular expressions that must all match the English answer; 'pages' are the printed pages that state the answer; 'danger' lists the danger signs a correct screen must raise. Out-of-scope items must be refused.
